description.narrative: - The Act on militia and self-defense forces was revised to remove all provisions that are against principles of C.29 on forced labour. Accordingly, the CEACR has acknowledged its satisfaction with the C.29 regular report which was submitted in Feb. 2020. - On the Act on militia and self-defense force, ILO has provided timely technical supports to MOLISA to persuade the responsible Ministries, Government, the National Assembly, and other stakeholders to revise the Act to be in compliance with the ratified C.29
